import ast
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
import uuid

sys.path.insert(0, '/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/scripts/aws')
from aws_cli import run, result

root = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd')
name = 'sdb-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
env = dict(os.environ, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_PAGER='', AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1', AWS_IGNORE_CONFIGURED_ENDPOINT_URLS='true')
for key in list(env):
    if key.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL'):
        del env[key]
path = root / 'testdata/aws/cloudwatch/dashboard_widgets.json'
capture = {'region':'us-west-2','caller_account':'000000000000','actor_arn':'','prefix':name,'sources':[{'path':__file__,'content':Path(__file__).read_text()}],'observations':[],'cleanup':[],'cleanup_verification':{},'evidence_boundaries':['One owned dashboard; body admission only, not rendering or widget query execution.']}

def save():
    path.write_text(json.dumps(capture, indent=2) + '\n')

def call(label, operation, parameters, service='cloudwatch', cleanup=False):
    started = time.time_ns() // 1000000
    process = run(service, operation, parameters, env, options=['--debug','--no-paginate'], timeout=40)
    decoded = result(process, debug=True)
    headers = {}
    for line in process.stderr.splitlines():
        if 'Response headers: ' in line:
            headers = ast.literal_eval(line.split('Response headers: ', 1)[1])
    decoded['request_id'] = next((v for k,v in headers.items() if k.lower() in ('x-amzn-requestid','x-amzn-request-id','x-amz-request-id')), '')
    if service == 'sts':
        assert decoded['code'] == 'Success' and decoded['output']['Account'] == capture['caller_account']
        capture['actor_arn'] = decoded['output']['Arn']
    capture['cleanup' if cleanup else 'observations'].append({'label':label,'service':service,'operation':operation,'input':parameters,'region':'us-west-2','caller_account':capture['caller_account'],'actor_arn':capture['actor_arn'],'request_started_ms':started,'result':decoded})
    save()
    return decoded

def widget(kind, properties):
    return {'widgets':[{'type':kind,'properties':properties}]}

metric = {'region':'us-west-2','metrics':[['AWS/EC2','CPUUtilization']]}
variable = {'type':'property','property':'region','inputType':'input','id':'r'}
cases = [
    ('period-override-number',{'widgets':[],'periodOverride':1}),
    ('start-invalid-string',{'widgets':[],'start':'bogus'}),
    ('end-without-start',{'widgets':[],'end':'2026-09-23T00:00:00Z'}),
    ('text-unknown-background',widget('text',{'markdown':'owned','background':'bogus'})),
    ('metric-unknown-view',widget('metric',dict(metric,view='bogus'))),
    ('metric-empty-metrics',widget('metric',{'region':'us-west-2','metrics':[]})),
    ('metric-string-row',widget('metric',{'region':'us-west-2','metrics':['AWS/EC2','CPUUtilization']})),
    ('log-empty-properties',widget('log',{})),
    ('alarm-empty-alarms',widget('alarm',{'alarms':[]})),
    ('alarm-unknown-state',widget('alarm',{'alarms':[],'states':['BOGUS']})),
    ('explorer-empty-properties',widget('explorer',{})),
    ('chart-empty-properties',widget('chart',{})),
    ('custom-empty-properties',widget('custom',{})),
    ('variable-empty-object',{'widgets':[],'variables':[{}]}),
    ('variable-missing-property',{'widgets':[],'variables':[{'type':'property','inputType':'input','id':'r'}]}),
    ('variable-unknown-type',{'widgets':[],'variables':[dict(variable,type='future')]}),
    ('variable-unknown-input',{'widgets':[],'variables':[dict(variable,inputType='future')]}),
    ('variable-boolean-default',{'widgets':[],'variables':[dict(variable,defaultValue=True)]}),
    ('variable-select-no-values',{'widgets':[],'variables':[dict(variable,inputType='select')]}),
    ('variable-count-26',{'widgets':[],'variables':[dict(variable,id='r'+str(i)) for i in range(26)]}),
]
for period in [1,5,10,20,30,60,90]:
    cases.append(('metric-period-'+str(period),widget('metric',dict(metric,period=period))))

call('identity','get-caller-identity',{},'sts')
try:
    call('create-control','put-dashboard',{'DashboardName':name,'DashboardBody':'{"widgets":[]}'})
    for label,body in cases:
        call(label,'put-dashboard',{'DashboardName':name,'DashboardBody':json.dumps(body,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))})
        call(label+'-retained','get-dashboard',{'DashboardName':name})
finally:
    call('delete-owned','delete-dashboards',{'DashboardNames':[name]},cleanup=True)
    absent = call('verify-absent','get-dashboard',{'DashboardName':name},cleanup=True)
    remaining = call('verify-prefix','list-dashboards',{'DashboardNamePrefix':name},cleanup=True)
    capture['cleanup_verification'] = {'dashboard_absent':absent['code']=='ResourceNotFound','prefix_empty':not remaining.get('output',{}).get('DashboardEntries')}
    save()
print(json.dumps({'fixture':str(path),'observations':len(capture['observations']),'cleanup':capture['cleanup_verification']}))
